description: This file contains utility functions for handling snapshot directories, copying files and directories, and managing snapshot metadata in a C++ project related to Android Open Source Project. It includes functions for copying directories recursively, handling symbolic links, and generating or loading snapshot metadata JSON files.

methods.name: IsFifo
methods.description: Checks if the given file stat indicates a FIFO special file.

methods.name: IsSocket
methods.description: Checks if the given file stat indicates a socket.

methods.name: IsSymlink
methods.description: Checks if the given file stat indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: IsRegular
methods.description: Checks if the given file stat indicates a regular file.

methods.name: CopyDirectoryImpl
methods.description: Recursively copies contents from source directory to destination directory, handling symlinks, special files, and copying file metadata.

methods.name: RealpathOrSelf
methods.description: Returns the real path of a given path, or the absolute path if realpath fails.

methods.name: CopyDirectoryRecursively
methods.description: Copies a directory recursively from source to destination, with optional verification that destination is empty.

methods.name: InstanceGuestSnapshotPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to the guest snapshot directory for a given instance based on metadata JSON.

methods.name: CreateMetaInfo
methods.description: Creates a JSON object containing metadata about a snapshot, including paths and environment info.

methods.name: SnapshotMetaJsonPath
methods.description: Returns the file path for the snapshot metadata JSON file.

methods.name: LoadMetaJson
methods.description: Loads and parses the snapshot metadata JSON file.

methods.name: GuestSnapshotDirectories
methods.description: Retrieves the list of guest snapshot directories from the snapshot metadata JSON.
